messages:
olga: dropped a slim row variant for autoscale: single-line steppers (min/max), tiny burst icon, and optional microline for cost/latency. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/slim-rows (frame C)
ravi: engineering: make steppers arrow-key friendly and support debounced saves (750ms). also ensure burst popover is accessible (aria-haspopup, role=dialog).
tess: visual: burst icon should be icon-only with 16px thunder, subtle border. add a 1px divider between steppers and burst to avoid looking cramped.
sarah: accessibility checklist: burst needs aria-label with pool name, stepper changes in an aria-live polite region, focus order min -> max -> burst, contrast >=4.5:1 for small text. tooltips must be keyboard-focusable.
mikey: copy tweak: use 'Short burst' everywhere. microline copy: "est +$0.10/min • est p95 +10ms" (muted). I'll update mocks and add touch-target checks (44px) for mobile.
